'''Watto's Cube with objective packs Cube''' is a format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>wattos_cube_with_objective</code>) with a deck size of 40 cards. Its definition links to the Players Committee [[Cube]] page.<ref name="gemp" /> GEMP's sealed league types include a league of the same name that uses this format.<ref name="sealedtype" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 40 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
